node.title: FPC5 Hankel split locators are exact GRS syndrome shells
node.statement: For an FPC5 Hankel chart with locator degree d and c recurrence rows, put D=d+c. Primitive core-split locators are canonically bijective with weight-d vectors in the syndrome fiber of the D-row weighted Vandermonde parity check on the core. If D<N this is an exact radius-d shell of RS[F,Core,N-D]; if D>=N the fixed chart contains at most one primitive locator. Distinct supports in the noninjective range intersect in at most d-c-1 points. Background, owner, and chronology guards are retained.
